title: Question 23
passage:
I booked one seat for the talk, but my niece is coming too.
A. The speaker used to teach at her school. B. I can see whether the seat next to yours is still free. C. Your copy of the program is already printed.
passageZh:
我預訂了講座的一個位子，但我兄弟姊妹的女兒也會來。
A. 講者以前在她的學校任教。 B. 我可以看看你旁邊的位子是否還有空。 C. 你的那份節目單已經印好了。
